entities.name: Mendy López
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mendy López Aude is a Dominican former professional baseball infielder and coach who currently serves as the manager for the Saraperos de Saltillo of the Mexican League. He played in Major League Baseball for the Kansas City Royals, Florida Marlins, Houston Astros, and Pittsburgh Pirates from 1998 to 2004, and in the KBO League for the Samsung Lions in 2004.
